i.norm: When accumulate=true, each selectFrom() call adds to the running character set. The union of all calls below is {'a','b','c','d','e'}, so every generated char must be found in "abcde". When accumulate=false (default), each selectFrom() call resets the set. The last two calls are selectFrom(null) and selectFrom() — both clear the set to empty — so the generator falls back to the full Unicode range. Characters from "abcde" are therefore effectively never produced (probability ~5 / 1_114_112).
accumulate=true → char must be in allowedChars accumulate=false → char must NOT be in allowedChars (full-range fallback)
